name: @ortho-earth/voxel
description: Voxel grids for @ortho-earth/globe: fills the reserved map.addData kind "voxel" (VoxelData: a box or longitude/latitude/height region grid of scalar / RGBA cells), drawn as a same-frame overlay by ray marching (blocks: first solid cell, Minecraft-like; volume: trilinear, colormap, front-to-back; iso: the surface at a threshold) with clipping, scene depth, unified picking and a worker reader. WebGPU (shared device and depth) or WebGL2.
